name: @glimpse/desktop
description: Glimpse: record your screen with your camera in a bubble.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist-electron dist-renderer && bun build src/main.ts --outfile dist-electron/main.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron && bun build src/preload.ts --outfile dist-electron/preload.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron && cp -R ../web/dist dist-renderer

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Glimpse shows your camera in a bubble while you record.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Glimpse records your voice with your screen.
